## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete change and link its requirement or issue.

## Verification

List the exact commands run and actual outcomes, including skipped or failed checks.

## Review

- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior and relevant failure modes using synthetic data.
- [ ] No secrets, raw health questions, private screenshots or medical records added.
- [ ] Source permission/review/scope and citation guards remain intact.
- [ ] API/schema/dependency/architecture changes have the required approval.
- [ ] No clinical, security or regulatory approval is claimed without evidence.
- [ ] Frontend revision is pushed before the root Git link is updated, if applicable.
- [ ] Known limitations and rollback considerations are documented where relevant.
